scope: Static corrected evidence collector plus six independently rerun authored index/member refusal tests on each Python runtime. No collector main, actual owner/journal/credential/HTTP/model use or live execution acceptance.
reviewer: Independent reviewer; did not implement corrected helper or authored tests.
checks: Five historical index digest constants independently matched their corresponding accepted historical independent audits: third-study recovery, stopped two-baseline attempt, issue-alignment follow-up, first-pilot continuation and original stopped pilot. Prior receipts remain unchanged.

Bounded exact-byte/SHA validation now precedes canonical parsing and journal iteration. Expected owner/run source identity, nonempty expected member count, byte total, exact directory membership/no extras and leaf-name path checks are enforced. Individual inputs use bounded size/SHA plus O_NOFOLLOW and symlink refusal.

Own execution of six supplied authored tests per runtime passes: original empty/altered index refuses on first index read without journal reads, re-bound empty/redirected index refused, changed/missing/extra/symlink/traversal members and index symlink refused, genuine authored index/member accepted.

Actual collector main remains static-only: nonblocking run and owner locks, readonly immutable/query-only SQLite, no sidecars and identical before/after control-file hashes, exact closed prior prefix/rows/namespaces, no inference, exclusive bounded retained outputs. Corrected historical verification gates original_journals_unchanged.
Old reviewed helper and original C01 finding are preserved; no financial/protocol/launcher implementation was changed by reviewer.

test_harness.startup: Stripped environment and isolated no-site Python, no sockets/subprocess/SQLite/native operations, file reads restricted to exact helper/test/public source and writes to reviewer temp.
test_harness.preserved_initial_harness_refusals: Initial bytecode cache read and fd-relative tempfile cleanup were over-restricted. Original probes/logs retained. Helper/test source-only loading and absolute-path cleanup restricted to reviewer temp corrected the harness without changing implementation or assertion paths.

limitations: Function-level authored tests and static main inspection, not execution against actual journals or actual owner database.
Cooperative Python/file checks are not hostile-host or concurrent filesystem/native-loader isolation.
